families.family: Envelope, KDF, cipher modes, and output detectors
families.tested: Authenticated Salted__ envelope; solved-stage SHA-256/legacy-EVP/AES-256-CBC profile; CBC/ECB/CFB/OFB/CTR, legacy ciphers, Key Wrap, binary/raw-key handling, structural/key-shape/address detectors over declared corpora.
families.result: No P32 hit; established parent-stage profile remains the only positively calibrated profile.
families.untested: Custom KDFs such as scrypt/bcrypt/Argon2 and several large-corpus mode widenings; Phase 374's exact ECB/stream/Key-Wrap Stage 4 was costed but not run.
families.license: An authenticated cipher/KDF/toolchain clue, a new solved-vector precedent, or a separately preregistered finite widening with an explicit information-gain case.

families.family: Curated vocabulary, direct clues, and broad text corpora
families.tested: Literal clue words, creator/Telegram material, page text, curated core/bounded pools, medium Tier 1-3 corpus, case/hash/newline forms, and corrected-oracle backfills.
families.result: No hit in the currently authenticated and registered candidate universe.
families.untested: Unknown future source material; arbitrary dictionaries or more formatting variants are not a genuine residual family.
families.license: A new creator-authored artifact, changed authenticated corpus, or exact independently sourced P32 candidate.

families.tested: Literal fragments, every order-sensitive P(8,k) concatenation for k=1..8, established form expansion, direct seven-part analogies, and macro-augmented convergent panel candidates.
families.result: All declared concatenation families and converged semantic checkpoints are negative or recognition-only.
families.untested: Unauthored separators, wrapping grammars, and new fragment semantics remain conceivable but unselected.
families.license: A ninth creator-authored fragment or primary evidence fixing a grammar, separator, operator, and P32 consumer.

families.family: Solved Phase 2/3/3.2 prose and prior-password reuse
families.tested: Architect residual words, full decrypted sentences, whole blocks, prior solved passwords, Phase 3's seven parts in canonical and all 5,040 orders, X2SH4Y0QB15 corrections, and solved-boundary grammar transfer.
families.result: No hit; the forward grammar transfer generated no new material beyond Phase 270.
families.untested: Arbitrary subsets, cross-sentence splices, and alternative normalization combinations.
families.license: A local instruction fixing the exact source boundary, ordering, normalization, and consumer.

families.tested: Whole sibling outputs in both orders; prime/Stage-0 readings; internal parameters; authenticated parent prefix; split-final-BE direct consumers; calibrated solution-complete panel promotions.
families.result: Named role-separation constructions and independently converged candidates are negative.
families.untested: Half/interleave/restored-whitespace and unrestricted salient-part compositions; these are combinatorial possibilities, not selected candidates.
families.license: Primary evidence selecting one source object, exact boundaries/order, one transform, and one downstream consumer.

families.family: Architect PRIME BASICS, 16/7 rails, and transport role
families.tested: Clause coverage; BE REQUIRED selector; SOURCE CODES eligibility/provenance; exact split-final-BE prime rule on CP1141 and answer_321; blue, yellow, blue-then-yellow, intertwined rails; native transport graph.
families.result: Prime and minimal AND/OR constructions are negative; transport leaves two carriers and no established binding.
families.untested: Yellow-first, reversals, other interleaves, another source/rule, or a transform from answer_321/answer_322 to a consumer.
families.license: New primary evidence fixing the source, rule/direction/serialization, unique carrier, unique consumer, and transform.

families.tested: YOUWON, title rebuses, checkerboard words, DBBI/FAED numeric/binary transports, nibble packing, route/transposition/classical-cipher probes, candidate outputs, and corrected-oracle backfills.
families.result: No P32 hit; several local checkpoints survive only as recognition or unresolved upstream decode problems.
families.untested: The actual FAED decoder/DBBI relationship and Family-10 ordering-key reading; arbitrary new routes are not licensed.
families.license: An authenticated decoder, a named reordering rule, or a demonstrated page-local edge from DBBI/FAED output to P32.

families.tested: Binary SHA-256 forms, raw keys, space/LF/CRLF bases, retained raw-key chunks, authenticated image/font and creator-media bytes, page-native numeric transports, and source-level encoding applicability.
families.result: Declared byte representations and the pinned 83-asset P32 manifest are negative.
families.untested: Historical scripts/CSS/maps and other files excluded by Family 3's scope; excluded media/assets lacking suitable chronology or creator provenance.
families.license: A separately frozen raw-response family plus pre-P32 provenance/creator authorship, or a single excluded file whose provenance becomes authenticated.

families.tested: Full Tier-1 nopad base scope and smaller curated whitespace variants.
families.result: Existing nopad runs are negative; one declared coverage delta was never launched.
families.untested: The implementation-ready Tier-1 --whitespace-variants rerun: about 700,000 keystrings, historically estimated at roughly 1-2 CPU hours.
families.license: Already licensed as bookkeeping completion; it needs only an explicit decision to spend the compute, not new puzzle evidence.

families.family: Cross-blob salts, envelope relations, and concordance
families.tested: Distinct salt/block inventory, salt-derived operands, pairwise/cross-blob constructions including an independent ~35,000-case sweep, and multi-blob structural concordance.
families.result: No repeated-block, salt-construction, or exact concordance signal.
families.untested: Arbitrary salt arithmetic, offsets, shared-password theories, and Salt|Phase|Ion structural roles.
families.license: A source specifying a particular salt relation, offset, shared structure, or cross-blob consumer.

families.tested: Sixty-nine bounded materials from authenticated message IDs, block heights/times, date integers, and literal ISO/HTTP dates in declared forms.
families.untested: Other numbers, timestamps, padding widths, and date renderings not independently selected.
families.license: A newly authenticated milestone value plus evidence fixing its serialization and P32 role.

families.family: Bitcoin/on-chain derivations, key shapes, and containers
families.tested: Signer-provenance filtering, creator transaction graph/fingerprint, EC neighbor targets, hex64/WIF/BIP39 classifiers, and exact BIP38/mini-key/SLIP-132/descriptor/Core-record parsers over frozen corpora.
families.result: No new creator route, key recovery, valid secret container, key-shape hit, or exact prize-address match.
families.untested: Larger-corpus classifier/parser scale-up, checksum-guided one-error repair without a near-valid object, and raw transaction bytes as password material.
families.license: A parser-valid near-object, authenticated key/container clue, source-selected transaction-byte use, or separately authorized bounded scale-up.

families.family: External repositories, community claims, and chronology/code archaeology
families.tested: Archived headers/code context, pinned external fork, blob chronology graph, bounded community search, spam/fabrication checks, and creator-signed transaction routes.
families.result: No independent reproducible P32 candidate or hidden code/route survived provenance checks.
families.untested: Future fork commits, archive captures, creator media, historical DNS evidence, or independently published exact candidates.
families.license: A changed authenticated artifact or a specific reproducible claim independent of the known fabrication network.

families.tested: Successful sealed surface-input, calibrated solution-complete, and macro-augmented panels; only corrected valid runs count, with comparison-new promotions evaluated.
families.result: All promoted candidates from valid panels were negative; invalid delivery/filter runs carry no puzzle evidence.
families.untested: More samples, another model/provider, or arbitrary packet rewrites; these are instrument variations, not new puzzle families by themselves.
families.license: A primary-evidence packet delta or preregistered independent instrument whose expected information gain is distinct from repeating the same prompt.

families.family: Historical SOURCE CODES referents and source comments
families.tested: Eleven source referents through eligibility gates and 32 bounded prime/complement readings of the exact ordered historical source-comment pair.
families.result: Four source referents were newly registered but none became executable; prime readings produced only inherited/flavor tokens.
families.untested: Using raw historical responses or the comment pair in downstream password constructions.
families.license: Primary evidence selecting the referent, stable bytes, unit/boundary, operator, serialization, and a P32 consumer.
